d:
“Sun Sakhiye Prabh Milan Nishani” Shabad Kirtan nu Bhai Harjinder Singh Ji Sri Nagar Wale di meethi te ruhani awaaz vich suno, te Sarab Sanjhi Gurbani de naal Gurbani da anand lao.
Sarab Sanjhi Gurbani tuhade layi le ke aundi hai Nitnem, Japji Sahib, Jaap Sahib, Rehras Sahib, Ardas te Kirtan Sohila di roohani bani. Ithe tusi non-stop Gurbani, Shabad Kirtan te paath sun sakde ho jo tuhanu Waheguru naal jodda hai.
